parsed.name: MDSnC 声光可调滤波器射频合成器
parsed.description: MDSnC 是用于驱动声光可调滤波器（AOTF）的多通道射频合成器。它通过为各通道提供可调的射频频率和功率来控制 AOTF 的工作状态，常用于光谱、显微成像和激光实验中的波长选择与光强调节。
parsed.description_en: The MDSnC is a multi-channel RF synthesizer used to drive an acousto-optic tunable filter (AOTF). It controls AOTF operation by supplying adjustable RF frequency and power to individual channels, and is commonly used for wavelength selection and light intensity control in spectroscopy, microscopy, and laser experiments.
